# Miramar Forklift Training

> OSHA-aligned forklift operator training and certification in Southern California and Nevada. Our main service is onsite training: our trainer comes to the employer's warehouse, plant, distribution center or job site and certifies the crew on the equipment they use every day. We also run hands-on classes at our training centers in San Diego, Las Vegas and Fresno, and offer an online course for renewals and operators outside our service areas.

Miramar Forklift Training is the training division of Miramar Forklift, a forklift sales, rental and service company based in San Diego. Training covers OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178 requirements: formal instruction, practical training and an evaluation of each operator's performance in the workplace. Operators receive a same-day certificate and wallet card. OSHA requires operator re-evaluation at least every 3 years.

## Training options (in order of what most employers choose)

1. Onsite training at your facility: for employers with crews to certify. Quote-based (depends on number of operators, equipment types and location). Free quote: https://training.miramarforklift.com/en/request-quote
2. Hands-on classes at our training centers: for individuals and small groups. Standard Forklift Certification (sit-down counterbalance and electric pallet jack) is $280 per person. Reach Truck + Forklift and Order Picker + Forklift are $490 per person. Train the Trainer is $750 per person. Book a class: https://training.miramarforklift.com/en/book-training
3. Online forklift operator course: $45. Covers the formal instruction (classroom) part. OSHA also requires practical training and an evaluation at the workplace, which the employer or a qualified trainer must complete. Details: https://training.miramarforklift.com/en/online-forklift-certification

## Training centers

- Las Vegas: 3301 W Martin Ave Ste A, Las Vegas, NV 89118. Equipment: sit-down counterbalance forklift, reach truck, order picker, electric pallet jack.
- Fresno: 3515 N Sabre Dr, Fresno, CA 93727.

Class dates and times for each center are shown live on the booking page. Onsite training is available throughout San Diego County, the Las Vegas area (Clark County) and the Fresno area; ask about other locations.

## Equipment we train on

Sit-down counterbalance forklifts (LPG and electric), electric pallet jacks, reach trucks, order pickers. Scissor lift and aerial lift training is available in San Diego.

## Quick facts

- Is forklift certification required? Yes. OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178(l) requires employers to train and evaluate every forklift operator before they operate a forklift.
- How long is it valid? Operators must be re-evaluated at least every 3 years, and sooner after an incident, a near miss, unsafe operation, or a change in equipment or workplace.
- Is online-only certification enough? No. Online covers the classroom portion only. OSHA also requires hands-on practical training and an evaluation on the equipment at the workplace.
- How fast? Hands-on classes take about 3 to 4 hours for beginners and 1.5 to 2 hours for experienced operators. Certificate and wallet card the same day.
